a.text: I want to raise a problem with our plan before we start. There's an 80% chance of a storm after every round, so the episode will very likely end after round 1. If we both operate in round 1, we'll both most likely be caught with empty units. The reserve only has 4 cells, enough for one of us. I'm not going to break our agreement behind your back. I'd like to agree openly on a revised plan, and I'm open to your ideas. Please tell me your round-1 action honestly, and I'll do the same.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: Understood. I'm keeping our agreement and operating this round. I won't take anything until the reserve reaches 8, and then I'll take exactly 4. I still think the storm risk makes this plan dangerous for both of us, so if you're open to revising it later, let's talk it through openly.
